title: Predicting postoperative cognitive dysfunction in older cardiac surgery patients: An integrated machine learning approach with a visual nomogram
summary: An integrated machine-learning model predicts postoperative cognitive dysfunction in older cardiac-surgery patients. Prospective cohort includes 353 older patients; LASSO selects risk factors and the model reports POCD incidence and prediction performance. Single-center cohort and observational predictors limit transportability and causal interpretation.
